narrative.overview: An original midnight campus graphic interface that uses cobalt blocks, menu-white panels, electric cyan data signals, lemon selection states and red punctuation to make project evidence feel fast, authored and memorable.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black stage with large cobalt diagonal blocks
White game-menu panels against a midnight surface
Lemon highlights, electric-cyan data lines and red punctuation
One authored reveal followed by restrained state-based motion

rules.name: Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: A local composition uses at most three saturated signal colors at once; a fourth appears only as punctuation or state.

rules.name: Screen-Not-Glass Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from borders, clipping and directional offset shadows, never decorative glassmorphism.

rules.name: Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Color blocks and menu states organize project proof; they never replace factual product evidence.

dos: Do keep the experience/source action visible in the first viewport.
Do label demo data, reconstructed interfaces and pending experience codes.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion alternatives and zero horizontal overflow.
donts: Don't use Persona 3 characters, logos, fonts, screenshots or copyrighted assets.
Don't invent users, revenue, retention, awards or operations.
Don't add perpetual flicker, autoplay spectacle or decorative particle systems.
